player_prompt.intro:
Esi ŋkɔ nyɛ Dɔdzikpɔla {player_id} le Chopsticks me. Le ɖoŋɔ la, xɔ na ku ɖe:
  + Kɔ:  '[attack M O]'  si M wɔ nyɛ ɖo (0 kple 1), O wɔ ɖo ɖe ɖo (0 kple 1).
    - ɖo ɖe ɖo ŋkɔ ɖe va ɖi yi ɖe wɔ ɖo; si ɖi gbaa 5, ɖi va ɖi yi ɖe 0.
  + Wɔ:   '[split L R]'  ɖi wɔ ɖe na ɖo ɖe nyɛ ɖo ɖe L kple R (L+R = wɔ ɖe ɖo).
Xɔ na ku ɖe ɖo ɖe na ku ɖe.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Ele be Split natrɔ asi le wò asinuŋɔŋlɔa ŋu.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Invalid move. Use “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} kɔ kple P{opp_id} wɔ ŋkɔ ɖe {opp_idx}: ɖi va ɖi yi ɖe {opp_val} va ɖi yi ɖe {new_val}.

outcome.win: Futɔ la ƒe asi eveawo siaa ku.
outcome.draw: Míeto míaƒe mɔa ƒe akpa si le eƒe goawo dzi.
